title: A black beach covered in glacier ice
description:
Diamond Beach in Iceland is a black sand beach scattered with chunks of glacier ice. The ice breaks off into the Jökulsárlón lagoon, floats out toward the sea, and some pieces wash back onto the sand. Places That Shouldn't Exist, part of a series.

#Shorts #Iceland #DiamondBeach
